layers.title: Thermal inertia (THEMIS)

source.name: Mars Odyssey THEMIS Thermal Inertia Mosaic, Quantitative, 100 m/px · NASA/JPL-Caltech/Arizona State University/USGS

caveats: Incomplete coverage: THEMIS has no data for part of the area (see coverage).
Thermal inertia is ~20 % accurate and describes only the top few centimetres of the surface.
100 m pixels average over rocks, sand and dust; classes are indicative, not a trafficability guarantee.
Not ground-truthed: no rover has operated in Arcadia Planitia.

layers.title: Roughness (HiRISE DTM)

source.name: Derived from MRO HiRISE DTMs · NASA/JPL/University of Arizona (derived)

caveats: Class breaks (0.25 / 0.5 / 1 m) are a Role B assumption, not team-agreed; NASA publishes no suited-walking roughness limit.
Mostly DTM noise (vertical precision ~tens of cm, Kirk et al. 2008): only crater rims and ridge flanks stand out.
Bumps narrower than ~2 m and boulders are not resolved; see the boulder review for rocks.
